title: A Bernstein-type theorem for capillary graphs in a half-space
summary: We show that any entire, capillary minimal graph in a half-space must be linear in low-dimensions or, more generally, when some tangent cone at infinity does not split off a vertical line. We also show that the regular set of any entire, capillary-minimizing hypersurface must be connected, and we discuss connections with the one-phase Bernoulli problem.
